## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what changes for the user. Link an issue if relevant: Fixes #

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Identify anything untested.
For native playback/download changes, include device/OS details and distinguish deterministic tests from live upstream outcomes.

## Screenshots or measurements

Include before/after screenshots for UI changes or timings for performance changes. Use generated or redistributable media and remove sensitive data.

## Review notes

- [ ] This change is focused; larger design changes were discussed first.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, private media, signing files or generated build output are included.
- [ ] Dependency, permission, storage and license changes are explained, if any.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under GPL-3.0-only.
